entities.name: Imbraham
entities.description: A stern owlin bird wizard, instructor and Dean of Theory at Quandrix College, killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: Student who finally claimed Imbraham's bounties.

entities.name: Adrix
entities.description: Took over Imbraham's role as Dean of Theory.

events.summary: Zimone Wola's arrival in his classes brings the first claim on Imbraham's bounties.
events.quote: bounties which remained untouched until the arrival of Zimone Wola in his classes

events.summary: Imbraham is killed during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Imbraham, like many other Strixhaven teachers, was killed.

events.summary: Adrix takes over as Dean of Theory of Quandrix.
events.quote: His role as Dean of Theory of the Quandrix College was later taken over by Adrix .
